ns2:course.label: EM Waves in Inhomogen Media
ns2:course.description: Electromagnetic waves in layered media; plane wave expansion of electromagnetic point source field; Sommerfeld integrals; transient response; WKB method with asymptotic matching; scattering by junction discontinuity; surface integral equation; volume integral equation; inverse problems. Prerequisite: MATH 446; ECE 520 or PHYS 505.
